authority: User explicitly delegated review and finalization: You can review and finalize it, make sure its best.
method: Read all sixty named patient financial journeys, original charges and prospective allowed amounts, chronological attempts and exact signed AR steps, final balances and selected patient costs.

Inspected complete linked source journals in the sample and independently checked every original line total, each running claim AR balance, and every linked whole-journal debit/credit total across all sixty cases.

Reviewed synthetic recognition, revenue versus cash, liability versus outstanding receivable, carry-in versus current revenue, inventory consumption, payroll accruals, salary top-ups, source-period bridges, pooled expense and selected allocation-run semantics.

Reviewed monthly monetary versus statistical units, Axiom vintage availability, original/revised budgets and ex-ante forecasts; nine independent full-population financial controls pass with no critical findings. Full regression and recovery evidence is required separately by the technical acceptance gate.
Confirmed the final policy clarification rebuild leaves all sixty reviewed financial trace bytes identical; rebound the selected source fact hashes to their final generation provenance.

resolved_findings.resolution: Exclude historical completed services from current recognition even when their earlier encounter publication lacked final discharge. Opening balances are equity-backed context, not new revenue.
Derive room days from actual occupied bed intervals and physical departure, rather than arrival or clinical admission. Unplaced holding never generates a licensed room charge.
Charge explicit local holding-hour services beyond a four-hour bundled allowance. Preserve partial hours, month splits, actual source knowledge and payer estimates without asserting bed occupancy.
Recognize known ADMIN salary entitlement less captured ADMIN shift cost, including late assignment and attendance true-ups. Sample-rostered support workers are not incorrectly excluded from salary.
Separate pre-2023 portions of opening overnight shifts into opening payroll/equity rather than allocating them against nonexistent current patient activity.
Retain variable partial/full collections, aged patient credit losses, pending disputes and explicit final losses. Refunds and reversals have exact linked opposite cash/AR effects.

material_assumptions: Fictional adult US hospital network, USD, 2023-2025; synthetic economics and local service prices are not real payer tariffs, a DRG reimbursement engine, statutory accounts or accounting advice.

The selected service scope includes actual room/holding or attendance plus selected completed ancillary services; remaining care is bundled or outside captured scope. Resource histories are selected capture, with explicit salary and utilities assumptions.
Self-pay rows are original patient statement accounts and are excluded from the external-payer claim/denial denominator. Patient liability is assigned responsibility, not an outstanding balance.
Six-place stored allocation drivers, deterministic cent rounding, explicit nonpatient destinations and selected-run semantics preserve pool totals without counting expense twice.

The original frozen design remains unchanged. An explicit reviewed table-budget amendment retains all accepted clinical/resource facts and all financial history versions while keeping the 25-table envelope below two million records.
Source export/replay and final integrated release acceptance remain later phases. This review does not authorize building the analytics solution.
disposition: Accounting, allocation and reconciliation semantics approved for this synthetic financial scope, conditional on all four Phase 6 technical exit criteria passing. Full dataset release and healthcare analytics solution remain blocked until Phase 9.
